_notes: Scrapshell's root command, per docs/lore/os-lineages.md section 3 (quorum root model) -- lineage-specific, not universal like spec/probe, per docs/systems/console-commands.md ('a Scrapshell box's usr/bin should not contain elevate... a db/software/templates/ lineage base should define its own root-model command'). Only referenced from db/vfs/templates/scrapshell.json's usr/bin. Full quorum-vote state machine is out of scope for this pass -- root_claim effect reports the request as pending, doesn't model actual union-member voting yet. Design locked 2026-09-05, not yet implemented: a personal/single-user device (no other union members ever reachable) should degrade this to a 'solo claim' -- instant, self-attested, logged distinctly as SOLO -- unwitnessed rather than treated like a real witnessed quorum claim. See os-lineages.md section 3's 'undermanned fallback, made concrete' for the full reasoning (it's a genuine security tradeoff -- one compromised identity is enough for root on a solo claim, not just a lesser/simpler quorum). Needs Console.gd to know whether the current node is solo vs. multi-user before this can be built; quorum_required below still assumes the multi-user station case. Also design-locked 2026-09-05, not yet implemented: a successful quorum claim should persist as a hash-chained multisig ledger entry (RFC-2302's Local ledgers deployment mode, not the AnchorRecord type -- see os-lineages.md section 3's 'Quorum doesn't have to be re-litigated per action' for why AnchorRecord specifically doesn't fit) carrying a TTL, so root survives for that window without a fresh vote per trivial action. The ledger only notarizes that N real co-signatures happened; it never grants authority by itself, which is the whole point -- don't build this as 'one key unlocks root.'
help: claim root --union-vote -- request root via union quorum vote
synopsis: Request root on this box via Scrapshell's union quorum model -- root is granted by vote, not sudo.

options.desc: The only supported root model on Scrapshell. Submits your own second and waits on the rest of the quorum.
